description: Runs a full LintBase scan against a Firestore database. Detects schema drift, security issues, performance problems, and cost leaks. Returns a structured report with a risk score and actionable issues. Use this before writing any database-related code to get ground-truth schema context.

collections.description: Optional list of collection names to scan. Omit to scan all collections.

keyPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the Firebase service account JSON file.

sampleSize.description: Max documents to sample per collection (default: 50, max: 500).

name: lintbase_scan
title: LintBase Full Scan
